explanationMd: A complete sentence needs an independent clause. "The rain ended" supplies a subject and finite verb, while the before clause establishes timing.

distractorRationale.c: Ending does not supply a finite verb for the main subject.
distractorRationale.a: This contains no complete main clause.
distractorRationale.d: Although makes the entire group dependent, leaving no main clause.
